title: Tool-Augmented Large Language Models for Reliable Medical Calculation from Patient Notes
abstract: arXiv:2610.21477v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Medical calculators translate raw patient observations into clinically actionable values and scores. However, applying these calculators directly to free-form patient notes requires precise variable extraction combined with the exact execution of complex formulas, scoring rules, and output conventions. Relying solely on direct large language model (LLM) prompting is unreliable in this context, as rule recall, parameter extraction, arithmetic reasoning, and formatting become entangled within a single generative step. To address these limitations, we propose a tool-augmented LLM framework for reliable medical calculation from patient notes. The framework retrieves and structures calculator specifications, generates reusable executable tools, and uses a constrained extractor to map each patient note to calculator-ready inputs. translated_title: 工具增强的大型语言模型用于从患者病历中进行可靠的医学计算
translated_abstract: 医学计算器将原始的患者观察数据转化为具有临床可操作性的数值和评分。然而，将这些计算器直接应用于自由格式的患者病历，需要精确的变量提取与复杂公式、评分规则和输出规范的确切执行相结合。在这种情境下，仅依赖直接的大语言模型（LLM）提示是不可靠的，因为规则回忆、参数提取、算术推理和格式化都纠缠在单个生成步骤之中。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了一个工具增强的LLM框架，用于从患者病历中进行可靠的医学计算。该框架检索并结构化计算器规范，生成可复用的可执行工具，并使用受限提取器将每份患者病历映射为计算器可直接使用的输入。随后由工具执行确定性计算，将临床语言理解与规则执行相分离。
tldr: 该论文提出一个工具增强的LLM框架，通过检索并结构化计算器规范、生成可复用的可执行工具、并使用受限提取器将病历映射为计算器输入，将临床语言理解与规则执行分离，从而实现从患者病历中进行可靠的医学计算。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a tool-augmented LLM framework that achieves reliable medical calculation from patient notes by separating clinical language understanding from rule execution—retrieving and structuring calculator specifications, generating reusable executable tools, and using a constrained extractor to map patient notes to calculator-ready inputs.
